name: VitaSpring Biomedical Co. Ltd.
summary: VitaSpring Biomedical Co. Ltd. specializes in pioneering pharmaceutical solutions derived from cellular medicine. It previously operated as Shemn Corp. before rebranding as VitaSpring Biomedical Co. Ltd. in February 2020. The company was established in 2016 and its main operations are based in Irvine, California.
